recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical ensemble composition featuring a central heroic figure in red winter gear, flanked by diverse action characters and a large anthropomorphic polar bear in the background, set against a bright, snowy pine forest under a clear blue sky with falling snow particles.
coreVisualRelationships: Pyramidal character arrangement with the largest figure at the apex
High-contrast metallic title overlapping the central character's torso
Warm red and green costume accents against a cool blue and white environment
Direct eye contact from all characters to establish a serious, heroic tone
coreInvariants: Brushed metal texture on primary display text
Low-angle perspective on the main cast

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure is medium-shot scale; background bear is large-scale; flanking characters are slightly smaller to create depth.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, textured 3D title at the bottom third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the central face upward to the bear, then outward to the flanking characters, finally settling on the bold title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Limited to the top corners of the sky to maintain a dense, action-packed feel.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cool cyan and white for the background and atmosphere.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep crimson red for the central character's jacket and title fill.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Forest green and metallic silver for secondary costume details and text outlines.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value in the background; high saturation in the foreground subjects to pull them forward.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy vertical strokes with sharp, beveled edges
Integrated lightning-bolt or jagged cutouts on interior edges
characterSpecificRedesigns: Inner edges of characters feature mirrored zig-zag notches
Beveled metallic face with brushed texture
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact 3D display face paired with a clean, wide-tracked secondary sans-serif for legibility.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and verticality for the display title.
Clean geometric forms for the metadata text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic ensemble of four action heroes (two men, one woman, one large anthropomorphic polar bear in a tactical vest) standing in a snowy pine forest. The central man wears a red winter coat with fur trim. The lighting is bright and cool. Add a heavy overlay of falling snow.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, 3D metallic title across the lower third using a bold, condensed sans-serif. The title should have a red brushed-metal face and silver beveled edges. Add secondary metadata text in a clean, wide-tracked white sans-serif at the very top and bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the title text beveled and metallic?
Is the polar bear positioned centrally in the background?
Is the color palette dominated by red, white, and cyan?
Is the metadata text centered and wide-tracked?

postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent lighting direction across all characters
Ensure the 3D text doesn't obscure critical facial features
Verify the snow particles appear in front of and behind characters for depth
Confirm the metallic bevels have realistic specular highlights
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a pyramidal character stack with a high-contrast 3D metallic footer title and atmospheric particle effects to create a standard action-adventure marketing layout.
